submittedArguments.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE polished landscape map-editor workbench for "Mindustry", based on v160.7 MapEditorDialog. Opaque 16:9 full screen, requested native 2560 x 1440. This is a static client art concept showing editing in progress.
Input images: approved mail UI and team UI are PRIMARY visual references. Match their refined Daoist chibi hand-painted finish, jade-green enamel active controls, warm ivory paper panels, thin gold borders, soft rounded cloud corners and restrained red tassels. Never copy their mail/party content or Chinese game title.
A functional editor, not a game combat HUD: central map canvas 66% width, narrow left tool palette 15%, right material palette 19%. Compact top bar and narrow bottom status bar. Decorations restrained, maximize editable workspace.
Top bar: small "Mindustry" left, heading "地图编辑器"; filename "云岫试炼 *" beside an amber "未保存" indicator. Right controls "保存", "测试", "菜单" with distinct clear icons. Jade primary Save; others ivory. No combat resource bar.
Central map is a true orthographic TOP-DOWN tile grid viewed from overhead, rectangular editing canvas. Bright natural pale gray stone ground, clusters of copper ore at upper-left, shallow teal river curving along lower-left, low rounded cliffs at upper edge, tree clumps beside cliffs, two small jade/bronze factory buildings and a contiguous orthogonal conveyor near center-right. A clear little jade base core toward bottom-right. All machine footprints conform to the square grid. Gray subtle square grid overlays the whole map, stronger but not opaque 3x3 square brush outline near center-left. One small cursor at brush. No isometric perspective, no human portraits, no giant decorative landscape border inside canvas. Sparse placement leaves editing space.
Left ivory tool panel heading "工具". 3-column grid of twelve generous icon buttons:
row 1 "菜单", "网格", "缩放";
row 2 "撤销", "重做", "取样";
row 3 "直线", "画笔", "橡皮";
row 4 "填充", "喷涂", "旋转".
Each has simple clear painted icon plus short readable label. "画笔" selected jade, "网格" toggle enabled, "重做" gray disabled. Below: label "画笔大小 3" and horizontal slider. Below that "阵营" and a row of 4 colored circular team buttons, first gold selected. Then three checked rows "显示建筑", "显示地形", "显示地表". Last cream button "居中".
Right ivory material panel: jade heading "方块". Search field "搜索方块". Category tabs "地表", "地形", "建筑", with "地表" selected. Below show a neat 3-column by 4-row grid of actual top-down square ground material swatches, consistent with the selected ground category: stone, sand, grass, snow, shale, shallow water, deep water, dirt, dark sand, metal floor, salt, ice. NO drills or turrets in this ground-only grid. First stone swatch selected with gold border. Selected item detail at lower-right: large stone tile icon and name "石地". Two small labels "当前图层：地表" and "旋转：0°".
Bottom status bar: "256 × 256" left of canvas, "X 128  Y 96" center, "缩放 100%" right; tiny far-right note "演示地图".
Legible Chinese, aligned controls, no duplicate overlays. Ivory blank areas remain quiet. High quality hand-painted game icons and clean crisp map details, no pixel art, no realistic skin, no plastic shine, no "五行奇谈", no watermark. Target configured GPT Image 2.5 highest quality.
